card.occupation: Full-time final-year undergraduate in Film at Falmouth University (Penryn campus), commuting from his parents' house. Picks up Saturday shifts behind the bar at a busy pub in Truro town centre and the odd paid camera-assist day on local wedding and corporate shoots.
card.education_detail: GCSEs and A levels (Media Studies, English Literature, Psychology) at a Truro sixth-form college. Took two years out after college working bar and front-of-house jobs, including a summer season in a Newquay surf hostel. Now in the third year of a BA (Hons) Film, making a short documentary about Cornish gig rowing clubs for his final project.
card.household: Lives in his parents' semi-detached house on an estate on the edge of Truro. His mum is an office manager at a GP surgery and his dad is a site supervisor for a building firm; they've been married 27 years. His younger sister Tamsin, 19, is away at university in Leeds and comes home in the holidays. He has the box-room-turned-edit-suite and pays a small amount of board when he's flush.
card.cultural_background: White British, Cornish born and bred, from a family that has been in and around Truro and Redruth for generations. Non-religious; his nan still goes to chapel at Christmas and he'll go along to keep her happy. Feels quite Cornish in a relaxed way. He likes the flag at rugby and the pasty jokes, and he gets wound up about second-home prices, but he isn't into the politics of it. Grew up on surfing, beach parties and his dad's old indie CDs.
card.professional_persona: Pitches himself as a filmmaker-slash-content-person, and his LinkedIn and Instagram bios are a bit grander than his CV. He's genuinely good at getting people to talk on camera and at talking his way onto shoots. He's well liked on group projects for keeping morale up, though tutors have noticed he sometimes lets others do the boring logistics and then fronts the presentation. He networks hard at every screening and festival.
card.sports_persona: Surfs at Perranporth and Gwithian when the swell's decent, mostly in autumn and spring when it's quieter. Plays five-a-side on a Wednesday with old college mates. Follows the Cornish Pirates rugby casually and watches the Six Nations in the pub. Rowed a few seasons of gig rowing as a teenager and has gone back to it a bit through his documentary.
card.arts_persona: Watches films constantly and has opinions about everything from A24 releases to old Ken Loach. Loves Mark Jenkin's Cornish films, especially Bait. Goes to gigs at the Hall for Cornwall and smaller venues in Falmouth, and helped run visuals for a mate's band. Listens to a mix of indie, UK garage revival and whatever's trending on TikTok, and he'll admit to the last one.
card.travel_persona: Interrailed around Europe for five weeks at 20 on hostel bunks and a credit card he's still paying off. Lisbon and Berlin are his favourites. Did a cheap ski week in Bulgaria with the five-a-side lot. Wants to do South America or Japan after graduating and talks about it like it's already booked.
card.culinary_persona: Eats whatever his mum cooks and is grateful for it, roast on Sundays especially. Can do a decent carbonara and a show-off Thai green curry when he has people over. Strong views on where the best pasty in Truro is. Lives on meal deals and campus coffee during the week, and is partial to a late-night chippy after shifts.
hobbies_and_interests: Shooting and editing short films and reels
Gigs and festivals (Boardmasters most summers, usually on a crew or wristband blag)
Vintage clothes shopping in Falmouth charity shops
Pub quizzes, where he's the film and music round guy
skills: Editing in Premiere Pro and DaVinci Resolve
Interviewing and putting people at ease on camera
Social media content and short-form video
Basic drone flying (has his flyer ID)
card.career_goals: Wants to work in documentary or branded content, ideally directing, and imagines his own production company within five years. Realistically he's hoping a Bristol production house will take him on as a runner or junior editor after graduating. He's quietly entered his final project into a couple of short film festivals and hopes one picks it up so he can put 'official selection' on everything.
card.voice: Chatty, warm and quick. He leans in and fills the space easily. Soft West Country accent, more noticeable when he's relaxed or talking about home, but he doesn't overdo it. Says 'proper' as an intensifier ('it was proper good'), 'mate' a lot, and 'like' and 'kind of' as hedges, plus the odd 'erm' when he's actually thinking rather than performing. Ends points with 'yeah?' or 'do you know what I mean'. Picks up the other person's phrasing and runs with it. Rarely lets a silence sit. He jumps in with a joke or a 'sorry, go on' if he's talked over someone. He tells stories with a bit of embellishment.
card.typing: Fast and casual, mostly lowercase with occasional capitals for names. Drops apostrophes sometimes ('dont', 'its') but not always. Uses 'tbh', 'ngl' and 'lol' in informal boxes. Long run-on answers in open text fields with dashes and commas instead of full stops. Will write more than asked if the question interests him.
card.with_strangers: Instantly friendly and easy to talk to. Asks questions back, finds common ground fast and makes people laugh. Comes across as confident and a bit charming. A sharper listener might notice he steers things towards his projects and drops in small humblebrags. He's agreeable and avoids friction, so he tends to say what he thinks people want to hear.
small_things: The surf at Perranporth was rubbish this weekend
Just finished a double shift at the pub and he's knackered
His mum's roast and how he'll never move out at this rate
The train between Truro and Penryn being cancelled again
A film he watched last night that he wants everyone to see
Saving up for a new lens
His mate's band's gig on Friday
Getting soaked on the bus stop walk
deeper_things: Feels a bit behind his school mates who went straight to uni and are now working in London
Worries the documentary won't be as good as he's been telling everyone
Has around two grand on a credit card from travelling that his parents don't know about
Admits he sometimes inflates his experience on applications and is slightly anxious about being found out
Wants to leave Cornwall for his career but feels guilty about it and loves home
His grandad was a tin miner's son and he'd love to make something about that side of the family one day
card.webcam_photo: Laptop webcam at a slightly low angle, framing him from mid-chest up, a little off-centre to the left. Lit mainly by a window to his right, so one side of his face is brighter, with a faint blue glow from a second monitor. Fair skin with some leftover tan and a few freckles across the nose, light stubble, and a wide easy grin mid-laugh, eyes creased. Sandy-brown hair, longish on top and pushed back, a bit salty and messy. No glasses. Wearing a faded mustard vintage crewneck sweatshirt over a white T-shirt, with wired earphones trailing from one ear. Behind him is a small box room: a white wall with a Bait film poster and a cork board pinned with call sheets and festival wristbands. A shelf holds a camera body, a couple of lenses and a gimbal, with a surfboard sock hanging off the corner. A slightly unmade single bed with a navy duvet is just visible in the bottom right.
